//: Overlay the default region's climate with a Svalbard winter. base_temperature ALSO sets the constant underground temperature (weather.cpp get_temperature, z<0). +1C is deliberate: cold enough that ordinary clothes leave the player chilled (pushing them toward the arctic-gear chain), but above freezing so water stays liquid and crafting never locks out — do NOT drop this to 0 or below. The arctic surface cold comes from the per-season manual mods, which only affect outdoor weather. thunder/lightning stay whitelisted because snowstorm can only upgrade from them (required_weathers).

name: Aurora
//: Clear polar-night sky with the aurora borealis overhead: a faint green light across the snow.  Upgrades from clear nights under high pressure; surface-only mood payoff for finally reaching the open air.
